paper: AlphaQuanter: An End-to-End Tool-Augmented Agentic Reinforcement Learning Framework for Stock Trading
headline_mechanism: AlphaQuanter learns a single ReAct-style policy that selectively queries market, fundamental, sentiment, and macro tools, then makes a high-conviction Buy/Sell/Hold decision using a multi-horizon outcome reward plus tool-efficiency incentives.

source_anchors.claim: The state accumulates query history and tool results; actions either query one of four information categories or terminate with Buy, Sell, or Hold.
The policy cycles through Plan, Acquire, Reason, and Act to gather evidence selectively before committing to a decision.
Outcome reward classifies an exponentially blended multi-horizon future return into bullish, bearish, or sideways regimes and favors high-conviction decisions.
The four information categories are market/technical, fundamentals, sentiment, and macroeconomic conditions.

preserved_elements: selective use of only two most informative tool categories per formation
high-conviction Buy/Sell/Hold diagnostic using the released 1.5 percent threshold
strictly chronological learning with a gap until every reward horizon is realized
common 0.1 percent one-way fee matching the released transaction-cost rate
approximated_elements: JKP characteristic bundles replace API calls and natural-language tool responses
recent price/attention characteristics replace unavailable news and Reddit sentiment
a market-regime and beta interaction replaces unavailable macro series and reasoning
rolling ridge tool weights replace the Qwen/GRPO policy and ReAct trace
continuous predicted confidence is retained for cross-sectional ranking while the native discrete threshold is reported diagnostically
invented_elements: the exact JKP features assigned to each tool category
monthly horizons of one, three, and six months
ridge penalty and deterministic top-two coefficient selection
common value-weighted long/short decile portfolio adapter
portfolio_adapter: The continuous past-trained decision confidence is ranked within the monthly top-1,000 universe and mapped to common value-weighted long/short deciles; the paper threshold is retained as a diagnostic rather than creating deterministic-ID ties among HOLD decisions.
claim_boundary: This is a researcher-authored AlphaQuanter-inspired selective-tool policy, not the unreleased Qwen/GRPO checkpoint, ReAct traces, multimodal test inputs, actions, or a reproduction of the paper's results.
